name: Voxel Face Mesh Generation
definition: Generates a single quad mesh for an exposed voxel face, populating a MeshData buffer with vertices, indices, normals, UVs, tangents, and vertex colors based on face direction and block type.
summary: Voxel Face Mesh Generation emits one unit quad per visible block face, creating computationally inexpensive, blocky geometry that strictly adheres to voxel grid axes without merging coplanar faces.
